title: astragalus echinus subsp. arabicus
intro: Astragalus echinus subsp. arabicus, commonly known as Arabic milk-vetch, is a plant species in the legume family that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects that can help to protect against diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Arabic milk-vetch, such as astragalosides, have been found to have a protective effect on the liver and kidneys.
